name: tinygpu
description: The smallest Vortex: one core of 2 warps x 2 threads with shared memory.

sources.all: A minimal reference machine for small FPGAs and fast simulation (1 core, NW=NT=2, shared memory at its default size); the ISA keeps the defaults (RV32IMAF/RV64IMAFD) so it runs the shipped toolchain runtime
